tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get the full public details of one listing: description, price in EUR, condition and quality grade, brand and designer, dimensions, materials, photos, seller reference and the whoppah.com link. Pass the id (or slug) from search_catalog. Every item is a one-off, so check it here before recommending a

tools.name: similar_items
tools.description: Find listings that look and read like a given one, to offer alternatives or comparisons. Pass a product id from search_catalog or get_item.

tools.name: get_seller_profile
tools.description: Public profile of a Whoppah seller: display name, private or business seller, biography, expert-seller status, and review score with recent review excerpts. Use it when the buyer asks whether a seller can be trusted. Never returns contact details: buyers and sellers talk through whoppah.com.

tools.name: list_brands_designers
tools.description: Look up Whoppah's brand and designer index, to spell names correctly, ground answers and build precise search filters. Use kind=brand or kind=designer with an optional name query.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the marketplace categories (slugs and titles), to build precise search_catalog filters.

tools.name: shipping_quote
tools.description: Shipping options and prices for one listing to the buyer's country (courier, parcel or pickup), as offered at checkout on whoppah.com. Pass the product id and a country code, e.g. 'de'.
